The case of the prosecution is that accused no.1 and 2 with an intention to grab the property from BDA, have created fake documents in respect of Site No.732 measuring 50X80 feet situated at Nagarabhavi 2nd stage, Bengaluru, thereafter the accused no.1 made representation to the BDA on the basis of GPA executed by Ramasubbaiah in favour of accused no.1 and the accused no.1 obtained lease cum Sale agreement (LCSA) and possession certificate from BDA on 06-01-1993,
thereafter in the year 2001 the accused no.1 on the basis of GPA, approached the BDA for execution of absolute sale deed, then the BDA insisted the accused no.1 to keep present Ramasubbaiah who executed GPA in favour accused no.1 and when the accused no.1 failed to keep present Ramasubbaiah, the BDA has conducted enquiry,
then finds that accused has created the GPA in the name of Ramasubbaiah and used the said forged documents as C.C.No.25697/2014 genuine and cheated the BDA by presenting the said forged documents with dishonest intention.
In pursuance of the complaint made by the CW.1 to the complainant police, the I.O has filed charge-sheet against accused no.1 and 2 for the aforesaid offences.
3. The accused no.1 and 2 are on bail and represented by their counsel,

After complying with the provision of Sec.207 of Cr.P.C., and on hearing both sides, charge was framed, read-over and explained to the accused no.1 and 2, for which they pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
Hence, case was posted for prosecution evidence.

4. The prosecution has examined 05 witnesses as PW.1 to PW.5 and got marked 15 documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.15 and Ex.D.1 Ramasubbaiah death certificate also exhibited by way confrontation in cross examination PW 1.
5.

The statement under Sec.313 of Cr.P.C., was recorded, read over, explained to the accused no.1 and 2 for which they pleaded not guilty and denied the incriminating circumstances which appeared against them.

Thereafter called upon them to enter into C.C.No.25697/2014 defence evidence, to which they submits no defence evidence to make and to file statement under Sec.(5) of Cr.P.C.,
6.
Heard the arguments.
Perused the documents on record.

1. Whether the prosecution proves that accused no. 1 with a dishonest intention along with accused no.2 has created the GPA in the name of Ramasubbaiah who has been died dated 17-12-1978 and also obtained lease cum sale agreement (LCSA) and possession certificate from BDA on 06-01-1993 by presenting the forged GPA which was alleged to the executed by Ramasubbaiah and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.465, 468 r/w 34 of IPC ?

2. Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that on the above mentioned date, time and place the accused no.1 along with accused no.2 C.C.No.25697/2014 with a common intention used the forged GPA as genuine Chowdappa Pi vs Janakiraman on 4 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83545616/
2 documents and filed application to the BDA for allotment of site accordingly, allotted the same and used the said documents as guenine and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.471 r/w 34 of IPC ?
3. Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that on the above mentioned date, time and place the accused no.1 along with accused no.2 with a common intention furnished the address of him by representing the said address belongs to deceased Ramasubbaiah at the time of allotment of site and he executed document in his wife name, for purpose to cheat the BDA with a dishonest intention and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.420 r/w 34 of IPC ?

Of course during the course of arguments Accused counsel submits that the prosecution has not secured the rest of the witness and their evidence has been dropped by this court and he relied upon ruling of Hon'ble Patna High Court rendered in Crl.Misc No. 27627/2018 between Surendra kumar V/s state of Bihar and Spl.Leave Petition No.3606/2024 between Arshad Neyaz khan V/S State of Jharkhand in which the Hon'ble Supreme Court and High Court of Patna held that if there is no allegation of impersonation by the Accused person over the execution of sale deed then it can not be said that it is forged documents and where there is no prima facie case, then Accused is entitle for acquittal etc.

But, admittedly the very significant documents in this case are that Ex.P.10 and Ex.P.11 C.C.No.25697/2014 they are death certificates of Ramasubbaiah, So as per said documents he has been died on 17-12-1978 further on perusal of the GPA that is Ex.P.6 dated 10- 11-1992 executed by A Ramasubbaiah in favour of Accused no.1 over the site no.732 of Nagarabhavi 2 nd stage that is alleged site of the case.

Further Ex.P.7 is possession certificate issued to the A.Nagaiah S/o.
Ramasubhaiah from BDA dated:11-03-1993 and Ex.P.8 is lease cum sale agreement dated 02-01-1992 alleged to the executed by the A. Ramasubbaiah in favour of Accused no.1, so on carefully comparison of dates between Ex.P.10 and Ex.P.11 and Ex.P.6 to Ex.P.8 documents they creates doubt about the living of A.Ramasubbaiah for the date alleged GPA of Accused no.1 that means as per the death certificate A.Ramasubbaiah has been died in the year 1978.
So execution of GPA as per Ex.P.6 and lease cum sale agreement as per Ex.P.8 in favour of Accused no.1 is not arise at all.
So Accused no.1 has created the GPA and lease cum sale agreement in the name of dead person A.Ramasubbaiah.

21. Further on perusal of the Ex.P. 2 application for site allotment dated 09-01-1987 and Ex.P. 4 form No. 1 dated 25-11-1986 and Ex.P. 5 allotment letter C.C.No.25697/2014 dated 22-03-1988 clearly confers to the court that after the death of A. Ramasubbaiah Accused no. 1 has applied for site in BDA in the name of A. Ramasubbaiah and same was allotted Site no.732 of Nagarabhavi 2nd stage and possession certificate also issued in the name of A.Ramasubbaiah and A.Nagaiah as per Ex.P.7.
So accused no.1 has created the Ex.P.6 to Ex.P.8 and other documents over the site no.732 in the name of dead person i.e., A.Ramasubbaiah.
Further another significant document is Ex.P.2 agreement of sale deed dated 24-04-1989 which was alleged to the executed by Nagaiah Son of A.Ramasubbaiah in favour of Accused no.1.

Further prime dispute in the present case is that about alive of Ramasubbaiah at the time of filling of allotment application to the BDA and other process, but as per the death certificates A.Ramasubbaiah has been died in the year 1978 itself, so question of application for allotment of site in BDA is not arise as per prosecution documents, further in pursuance of the Ex.P. 6 GPA and other documents Accused no. 1 used the said GPA as genuine one and he executed the sale deed in favour of Accused no.2 his wife as per Ex.P. 2.

So Accused no.1 and 2 knowingly created the C.C.No.25697/2014 GPA, sale deed, lease cum agreement of sale as per Ex.P.6 to Ex.P.9 documents by creating as well as forged the said documents in the name of deceased A.Ramasubbaiah and that too they used the said documents as genuine and also the created the all above said documents with dishonest intention and cheat the BDA and further on perusal of Ex.P.15 Tippani copy of BDA clearly indicates to the court that about ill-legal acts of the Accused no.1 to grab the site no.732 of Nagarabhavi 2nd stage,

Of course during the course of the cross examination PW.1 has admitted the Ex.P.D1 one death certificate of Ramasubbaiah dated:17.12.1988 but the said document is contrary to the Ex.P.10 and Ex.P.11 documents that is Ramasubbaiah death certificates.

23. Further either in U/s.313 Cr.P.C statement nor at the time of framing of charge Accused have not explained before the court that why police have implicated them in this case etc and also they have not stepped in to the witness box to prove their defence evidence about their genuineness of their documents and to prove their title and lawful possession over the site no.732 of Nagarabhavi 2nd stage.

So in the absence of the defence evidence and contrary material any C.C.No.25697/2014 amount of the arguments addressed by the Accused have not supports and also the rulings submitted by the Accused also not support to their case, because the facts and circumstance involved in the said rulings are entirely different from the present set of facts.

24. Accordingly,I am opinion that prosecution has proved it is case by way of oral documentary evidence that too by placing cogent, corroborative and convincing evidence and there is no discrepancies, omissions, are found in the prosecution case.
Of course prosecution witness admitted some of the points in their cross examination but, they have minor and to be neglected.

25. Further on Perusal of the over all materials that is evidence of PW.1 to PW.5 and Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.15 documents clearly indicates to the court that after the death of Ramasubbaiah Accused no.1 and 2 have created the GPA and other documents and applied for site with BDA and they succeeded in allotment and also obtained possession certificates and other documents from BDA and they used forged documents as genuine with dishonest intention and to grab the BDA site.

accordingly,
accused are liable for punishment for the alleged offences as per the charge C.C.No.25697/2014 sheet materials because prosecution has proved its case beyond reasonable doubt as per the ingredients of alleged sections that is section 465, 468, 471, 420 r/w 34 of IPC.
Accordingly answer this point no.1 to 3 in the AFFIRMATIVE.

From the discussions on foregoing points, this court opined that prosecution has proved it's case for the offences punishable U/s.465, 468, 471, 420 r/w 34 of IPC.
